title: 카드형 도감
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign ONLY the ABILITY LIST MODAL opened by the bottom-left '능력' button in the existing Korean vending clicker game, not the transient reward toast. One polished 16:9 full gameplay screenshot mockup per output. Reference image 1 is the existing screen to edit: retain the sunny Japanese backstreet and dimmed game HUD outside the modal, replace the unattractive tall list popup completely. Reference image 2 is ONLY the approved drink artwork reference. Match the same crisp arcade pixel-art language as the blue currency HUD: stepped square pixel frame, dark ink outlines, restrained navy/cyan/cream/gold palette, subtle bevels. NO rounded modern web-dashboard corners, no neon overload. Strong readable Korean display typography visually matching Cafe24 PRO UP chunky forward-leaning game font. Modal centered, comfortably fits within screen, title '능력', close X in top-right, small 'ESC 닫기'. This is a READ-ONLY ability collection viewer; NO buy/use/upgrade buttons, currencies to spend, locked skill tree or invented mechanics. Show six already-acquired drinks, visually recognizable and with correct shapes: 물 water plastic bottle, 녹차 green tea bottle, 보리차 barley tea bottle, 이온음료 blue ion bottle, 사과 주스 white carton, 진저에일 green bottle. Acquired counts respectively 3,4,1,2,1,1. Summary data (visual examples): '수색 9회', '발견 보너스 +13 Gold', '꽝 15%', '빈캔 12'. Distinguish acquired quantity from cumulative effect. Put tiny footer '수치는 시안 예시'. Do not cover frame with text, avoid tiny dense copy. No watermarks, no explanatory paragraphs outside the mockup. Direction A: COLLECTION CARDS. Wide compact modal approximately 80% screen width and 78% screen height. Blue pixel frame matching wallet HUD. Six clean horizontal collectible cards in a generous 3-column 2-row grid, with bottle icon left, Korean name and prominent small count badge right, one short effect caption beneath. Example captions: water '3개마다 수색 클릭 -1'; tea '발견 골드 +4'; barley '빈캔 +1'; ion '발견 골드 +4'; apple '발견 골드 +3'; ginger '빈캔 +1'. A separate full-width bottom strip of four stat tiles clearly titled '현재 누적 효과'. Light cream labels, cyan selected accent, subtle drink color tabs. Overall polished, cheerful, immediately scannable, faithful to existing blue pixel HUD.
